entities.name: Silas Duskmoor
entities.role: Right hand of demon god Diablo
entities.description: Member of the Duskmoor bloodline, an executioner known for spirit-infused blue flame.
entities.quote: Silas Duskmoor To dragons, he was ancestral nightmare. The Duskmoor bloodline carries spirit-infused blue flame. A legacy born from dragon betrayal and spirit vengeance.

entities.name: Tedmond
entities.description: Silas's father, a formidable warrior who once challenged Diablo.
entities.quote: Tedmond appeared in thay fight with out any invitation.his enterfearance made diablo shook!

entities.name: Dorian
entities.description: A warrior who fought alongside Tedmond and eventually joined the Nullborn.
entities.quote: Dorian was not in his prime because he was only a kid back then.but his battle iq and potential he alongside eldrich and norman faught diablo and his army.

entities.name: Eldrich
entities.description: An Aldercrest wizard cursed into half-demonic existence who masked his magic with demonic aura.
entities.quote: It was eldrich who was the caster basically,before that eldrich was cursed by khalid making him half demonic.

entities.name: Aeric
entities.description: A legendary figure known for forging powerful cursed weapons.
entities.quote: Another member who used that cursed weapon was none other than aeric.who is known for making cursed weapons.

entities.name: Soa
entities.description: A rare host of Athena's Judgement who died by suicide due to intense training pressure.
entities.quote: Soa was trained. Pressured. Burdened. She broke. Her suicide wasn’t just tragedy — it was the philosophical wound that shaped Dorian forever.

entities.name: Aldercrest
entities.description: A clan known for arcane strategies and hosting the rare ability Athena's Judgement.
entities.quote: So after that war,when aldercrest learns soa has that athenas judgements ability,which choses it's host very rarely.so aldercrest tried to train her.

entities.name: Nullborn
entities.description: A group that Dorian joined after the death of Soa.
entities.quote: After soas death,dorian had a very rough impact on his head and led him joining nullborn slowly.

timeline_events.title: First Diablo Incursion
timeline_events.description: Tedmond interfered in a major war against Diablo, forcing the demon to retreat.
timeline_events.quote: Tedmond appeared in thay fight with out any invitation.his enterfearance made diablo shook!and then we also see normans bravery and dorians madness too.yes!diablo had to fall back.
